longform.headline: Sound and image travel under contract
longform.opening: The atmosphere may feel fleeting; its music, images and consents are not free of ownership.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: Danish textile memory predates the contemporary week: Designmuseum Danmark describes thousands of fashion and textile objects, including historic costume and Danish design.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: CPHFW assigns brands responsibility for music clearance with Koda when they provide music on physical or owned digital platforms; organizer press assets remain separately terms-bound.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: A public runway stream or press image is not automatically reusable; this release installs no third-party item without item-level permission or an authorized embed path.

longform.closing: Copenhagen’s distinction is not a claim of purity. It is the decision to make participation depend on evidence—and the obligation to keep asking what that evidence cannot establish.
